**Dropnook 2.4.1** — copy the content of a text file.

* **Copy for text files:** txt, md, csv, log, json, yaml, xml, ini, conf, py, js and sh files (up to 2 MB) now have *Copy* like pictures do — in the file list, in the ⋮ menu (*Copy content*) and above the preview you get by clicking the name. It puts the whole content into the clipboard, not just the beginning the preview shows. Works without HTTPS too.
* Texts and help in all 17 languages.

Nothing to change on your side: *Check for Updates* → *Update* (with `DROPNOOK_VERSION=2`, *Compose Up*); open pages reload themselves. The Community Apps edition gets the update too.
